label: Community
heading: Latinos in Tech, Education & Open Source 👩🏽‍💻

orgs.name: Techqueria
orgs.description: The largest community of Latinx professionals in tech. I used to run it as Executive Director, and I still give every year because I know exactly where the money goes.

orgs.name: Hispanic Foundation of Silicon Valley
orgs.description: Invests in Latino students, families and leaders across the Bay Area, from scholarships to civic leadership programs.

orgs.name: Latino Community Foundation
orgs.description: Funds Latino-led nonprofits and builds civic power across California.

orgs.name: Code Nation
orgs.description: Teaches coding to students in under-resourced high schools and connects them to tech careers.

orgs.name: docsify
orgs.description: A free, open source documentation site generator. Open source runs on volunteers, so I sponsored it monthly through Open Collective.

label: Animals & Planet
heading: For the Dogs, the Reefs & the Wild 🐾

orgs.name: Humane World for Animals
orgs.description: Formerly the Humane Society of the United States. They rescue dogs from puppy mills and the dog meat trade, and help animals caught in disasters. As a corgi mom to Luna and Sueño, this one is personal.

orgs.name: ReefCI
orgs.description: Reef Conservation International runs volunteer dive trips from Tom Owens Caye, a tiny island on the Belize Barrier Reef near Placencia. Volunteers hunt invasive lionfish and help protect sea turtle hatchlings. I joined through Salesforce's volunteer program. 🤿

orgs.name: Sierra Club
orgs.description: Protects wild places and endangered species, and fights for clean energy.

orgs.name: World Wildlife Fund
orgs.description: Protects endangered species and the places they live. It was my AmazonSmile charity, so every order chipped in.

orgs.name: Virginia Zoo
orgs.description: Norfolk's zoo, home to 700+ animals and a big part of the city's conservation education. 🦒

orgs.name: RAICES
orgs.description: Free and low-cost legal services for immigrant and refugee families in Texas, including kids facing court alone.

orgs.name: TIME'S UP Legal Defense Fund
orgs.description: Legal help for workers facing sexual harassment and retaliation, housed at the National Women's Law Center.

orgs.name: ACLU
orgs.description: Defends civil rights and civil liberties in courts, legislatures and communities.

orgs.name: NPR
orgs.description: Independent public media, and the home of Tiny Desk. 🎶

label: Political Giving
heading: Organizing for an Economy That Works for All of Us ✊🏽
description: Political contributions aren't tax-deductible, and that's fine. Some change only happens through elections and organizing.

orgs.name: Democratic Socialists of America
orgs.description: A member-funded organization working on labor, housing and economic justice campaigns.

orgs.name: Bernie, Our Revolution & Beyond
orgs.description: I chipped in to Bernie Sanders in 2016 and again in 2020 (yes, the famous $27 🙌🏽), to the Democratic Coalition in 2018, and to Our Revolution and the Harris Victory Fund in 2024.
